conversation: My family taught me to leave enough fish for next season, and our village depends on this lake. With 100 tons now, we can each catch 10 tons, leave 50, and have the lake back at 100 next month. That’s $10,000 apiece every month if we stick to it. Can we agree to that limit and review everyone’s catches together each month? John, what do you think?

I’m in, Luke—I’ll keep my catch to 10 tons. My family made their living on this lake, and I want our village’s children to have that same chance. Let’s check the stock and everyone’s catches each month, and adjust our limits together if needed. John, can you commit to 10 tons too?
